$comment: Every error code a guest can observe on a rejected call. `fatal` codes also end the execution, even if the script catches them.

unknown_tool.meaning: no such stub; use search / describe

upstream_error.meaning: the upstream server returned an error, timed out or was cancelled

approval_required.meaning: the call needed human approval and none was granted

pin_drifted.meaning: the tool definition changed since it was approved

budget_exceeded.meaning: call count or byte budget exhausted
